Full baseline, all labelled judgement calls not hard rules; repo overrides: Mysterious Name: unclear function/variable/type names -> rename; if no honest name fits inspect design. Duplicated Code: repeated logic shape -> extract shared shape and call it. Feature Envy: method reaches into another object's data more than its own -> move near that data. Data Clumps: same fields/parameters travel together -> bundle domain concept. Primitive Obsession: primitive/string stands in for domain concept -> small type. Repeated Switches: repeated cascade on same type -> one mapping or polymorphism. Shotgun Surgery: one change needs scattered edits -> gather related behavior in one module. Divergent Change: module changes for unrelated reasons -> split by reason. Speculative Generality: abstractions/hooks for needs absent from spec -> remove or inline. Message Chains: long navigation callers should not depend on -> hide walk. Middle Man: function/class mostly delegates -> remove call target. Refused Bequest: implementer ignores inherited contract -> composition.
